name: The Relay
description: Couriers and lift crews work to remove tolls and open public roads. Iri needs help moving food and medicine, repairing crossings, and stopping collectors. Those same roads also let drilling companies reach the basin.

name: Glass Covenant
description: Archivists protect personal memories from sale and unauthorized copying. Sera needs help checking permissions and exposing forged records. Keeping the vaults cold uses water that nearby households also need.

name: Ash Foundry
description: Welders and heat engineers want safe shifts, paid rest, and shared control of the furnaces. Bram needs help repairing the city and ending inherited work debts. Cutting fuel use protects the forest but leaves some homes cold.

name: Null Choir
motto: Let people choose what they hear.
description: Interpreters and communications workers remove forced broadcasts and build accessible warnings. Ves needs help separating alarms from advertisements. Floods and shortages still threaten the neighborhoods after their speakers are switched off.
